description: This source file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetGlobal, which implements the getGlobal() method for the Smarty templating engine. It provides functionality to retrieve global template variables, either a specific variable by name or all globals.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetGlobal
classes.description: A class that provides the implementation of the getGlobal() method to retrieve global template variables within the Smarty templating system.

methods.name: getGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves a specific global template variable if a variable name is provided, otherwise returns all global variables.
